boundaries: Source topology and text inventory, not runtime parity or a C# semantic analysis.

Workflow scope, registration consumers and phase ownership are reviewed for P0-03. Per-control semantics, detailed dependency closure, reciprocal MAN/DEV links and translation classification are mandatory within each implementing slice, not P0 prerequisites.
Missing destinations are planning identities, never delivered registry IDs.
Read pinned archive Git objects; approved working-tree corrections are recorded in exav-baseline.json, not silently substituted.
Bundled LGPL source only; optional packs and experiments retain separate scope.
scopeDecision: Owner accepted workflow/consumer scope closure now and incremental per-control/dependency detail, reciprocal MAN/DEV and translation classification during implementing slices.

new-world.consumer: MainWindow New -> NewWorldDialog enumerates NewGameContribution -> provider createNewGame/createWorld; exactly empty and heightmap providers. TerrainOnly is an extension class, not a third registration.

save-session.consumer: MainWindow save/open/close, FileDropHandler and MruHelper route to owner save/restore or participant Leave. Source files/compression remain P0-05; preserve web authority/recovery.

clock.consumer: MainWindow timer commands and source-time display; server controls time, never local panel entry.

map.consumer: MainWindow map -> MapView; cut/preview and MapView-owned TrainTrackingWindow. Adapt window multiplicity to browser view/inspector without claiming continuous tracking delivered.

terrain.consumer: MainWindow terrain command -> MountainController corner raise/dig; construction mode remains required independently of retired launcher.

rail.consumer: MainWindow railway commands -> level/slope controllers; full source legality/cost and field semantics belong to P4.

special-rail.consumer: MainWindow enumerates specialRails -> SpecialRailPlacementHandler -> SpecialPurposeRailController(type); bridge/girder/tunnel/garage all retained.

speed-limits.consumer: Registered speed-limit menu -> level/slope controllers and orphan cleanup; preserve separate railway tools and train-state dependency.

stations.consumer: MainWindow station/passage commands; station/platform picking opens properties, station right-click opens information; bells enumerate registered contributions. Roof/material variants retained.

station-info.consumer: StationInformationWindow from station/property input; StationList through manifest dockingContent. Compiled StationListPlugIn has no selected manifest/production consumer; its duplicate menu is source-only.

train-info.consumer: System dockingContent -> TrainInformationWindow with nested train selection and Move; distinct from map-owned continuous tracking.

train-trading.consumer: MainWindow purchase enumerates trains; placement/group/sale panel binds World train tree and controller collection. Stable IDs, not group-name/index identities.

timetables.consumer: Toolbar/system dockingContent -> controller manager -> registered manual/TAT providers. TAT configuration uses modal map picking and station/junction forms; copy and .ftdd rule files are included.

manual.consumer: Registered manual provider creates controller; existing leased keyboard input is partial coverage. Preserve source defaults/help with browser focus/lease rules.

delegation.consumer: Non-temporary World adds delegation singleton, selectable from world controller collection; warning remains. This is not an extra manifest trainController provider.

direct-buildings.consumer: Commercial and variable-height definitions are scanned by development. Historical direct MainWindow commands are commented; surviving builders and unfinished variable-height builder/remover do not prove player entry. Retain required direct/catalog placement as an explicit planned P7 adaptation.

generic.consumer: Generic menu -> MultiSelectorController; CategoryTreeWnd is dockingContent. Picker enumerates GenericStructureContribution; only null-contrib plus its generated child are bundled. Do not reinterpret 121 direct building declarations as generic choices; populated catalog is P7 adaptation.

half-voxel.consumer: Half-voxel menu -> ControllerForm enumerates HalfVoxelContribution; color libraries are supporting selectors, not independent menu commands.

land.consumer: MainWindow ground cover/trade/bulldoze -> LandController registry groups and dedicated controllers. Fence, forest, farms, rice, creek, vinyl houses and random wrappers stay within land recipes.

roads.consumer: MainWindow conditionally adds one road construction entry; RoadController enumerates all three road definitions, not six invented menu contributions.

road-extensions.consumer: Menu registrations open selectors for RoadAccessoryContribution/DummyCarContribution, but bundled declarations supply zero instances. Preserve shell/API disposition; no bus gameplay obligation follows.

dummy-copy.consumer: DummyCarController is not in any pinned project Compile item and has no production consumer; registered ControllerForm/ControllerImpl is the separate extension route.

poles.consumer: Pole menu opens selector enumerating ElectricPoleContribution, then builder/remover.

signals.consumer: Signal menu -> SignalRailController enumerates RailSignalContribution. Signal harbor/controller interactions remain distinct from passenger stops.

rail-accessories.consumer: MainWindow accessory command -> StationaryStructPlacementController uses railStationaryGroup.

special-structures.consumer: MainWindow enumerates specialStructures; handler calls showDialog for Mountain2, terraces and stadium. Each provider owns its controller.

terrain-two.consumer: Mountain2 specialStructure.showDialog -> Mountain2Controller; rectangular raise/dig and repair.

terraces.consumer: Terrace specialStructure.showDialog -> TerraceController with placement/removal strategies.

stadium.consumer: Stadium specialStructure.showDialog -> PlacementController using anonymous StructureContributionImpl.groupGroup. Placed StadiumStructure input opens properties; anonymous is support, not a separate catalog command.

reports.consumer: System dockingContent -> AccountSummaryWindow -> history windows/GenreSelectorDialog. accountGenre instances feed category selector and transaction reports.

balance-sheet.consumer: MainWindow opens BalanceSheetForm, which loads static balanceSheet.html. Keep planned computed P8 report explicit; no source-calculated report is credited.

subsidiaries.consumer: System dockingContent registers MarketWindow; property transactions bind SubsidiaryEntity implementations, not every generic Structure input hook.

bank.consumer: Bank menu -> counter; dockingContent -> BankbookWindow. Timers/asset references are P0-05/P8 dependencies; menu reachability is established.

stocks.consumer: Stock menu -> StockMarketForm; dockingContent -> StocksWindow. Quantity/chart controls are support within these workflows, not independent commands.

options.consumer: MainWindow ConfigDialog and forced/source-clock appearance. Retain gameplay-affecting bankruptcy settings with server authority; local fonts/visibility/audio adapt to browser. Native allocation has no direct browser equivalent.

music.consumer: BGMManager consumes bundled bgms and Silence; MainWindow toggles sound effects. Platform properties consume registered departure bells. Bundled MIDI remains required.

external-music.consumer: A4 factory and BGMManager user-file selection are excluded by owner; temporary BGM/fileName is not another bundled command.

support.consumer: PluginListDialog, error details, help and About/embedded credits map to browser content diagnostics/help/credits/license. Preserve source notices and safe error boundaries.

color-test.consumer: Color-test menu opens ColorConfigDialog(ColorTestTrainCar.theInstance); colored-picture registry feeds templates. XML output is authoring support within this reachable workflow.

development-tuning.consumer: System {develop-config} menu -> DevelopConfigure; retain Apply/Cancel/Save/Load and shared development authority. Old source-only disposition is superseded.

land-value.consumer: Registered LandValueInspectorPlugin adds inspection route; land value simulation remains P7.

profile.consumer: parseProfile builds an unpopulated set; no functioning profile selection credited. Required explicit optional-pack support remains a separate owner requirement.

layout.consumer: Command dispatch, shared selectors, docking/window layout and engine callbacks support owning workflows. Port browser authority/focus/layout semantics, not native window APIs or independent commands.

resources.consumer: Factories, pictures, loaders, car definitions, palettes and account metadata feed owning recipes/workflows; do not count as independent player commands.

excluded-debug.consumer: Stable debug dockingContent remains owner-excluded; video plugin is absent from stable trunk. Ordinary error/content diagnostics are still in scope.

undo-redo.consumer: Pinned command/binding inventory has no implemented Undo/Redo command. Generic dispatch alone does not introduce a new parity requirement.

findings.title: Station information and station list
findings.behavior: Station right click and the property dialog Information button open live counters: name; loaded, unloaded and train calls today/yesterday; waiting passengers versus demand (population). Manifest dockingContent registers StationList through DockingContribution; its sorted list subscribes to world/station changes and double-click moves map views. Replace name/hashcode/index correlation with stable station IDs; preserve keyboard/touch access.

findings.title: Train information and continuous tracking differ
findings.behavior: TrainInformationWindow has nested group/train selection, name/state, car count, total capacity, passenger count/percentage and Move. MapView creates a separate TrainTrackingWindow with a tracking checkbox. System dockingContent registers TrainInformationWindow; this is a proven separate entry route. Existing web find-train/inspector is partial, not continuous tracking.

findings.title: Speed-limit construction and cleanup
findings.behavior: Registered menu initializes SpeedLimit and supplies level section, slope section and remove-not-on-traffic cleanup. Level tool has add/remove, two map endpoints and low/medium/high choices; slope tool adds four direction picks and its own interaction. These are railway tools, not alternative global clock speeds. Resolve exact speed values, slope placement/deletion and train movement in P0-04/06; do not infer units from translated labels.

findings.title: Second terrain tool
findings.behavior: Mountain2 rectangular raise/excavate uses RectSelectorController; Ctrl switches to checking and repairing mismatched adjacent corners. Keep the registered second tool distinct from MountainController corner editing and terrain image import; provide an explicit accessible repair action rather than requiring a global modifier.

findings.title: Report periods and history windows
findings.behavior: AccountSummaryWindow has six periods: today/yesterday, this/last month, this/last year. Context actions open daily and monthly histories; each offers sales/expenditure/balance, genre selection and fonts. Preserve 31-day/12-month columns and rollover semantics as P0-05/06 obligations. Close menu text without an event remains a source gap, not verified behavior.

findings.title: Timetable copy and station-rule files
findings.behavior: Controller manager adds copy with BinaryFormatter cloning and a unique derived name. Station advanced rules add copy, clear-all confirmation, read/append and save of .ftdd rule collections, duplicate time-mask checking on Add, and forwarding/reverse variants. Copy/import bypassing Add and sorted UI versus rule execution order require explicit P0-06 cases. Adapt source file dialogs to validated service commands/drafts; do not run BinaryFormatter in the browser/service. Historical day-from-month edit defect remains visible.

findings.title: Platform choices, cost and consumed passage materials
findings.behavior: Platform controller replaces slim checkbox with wide, slim roofed and slim unroofed radios; station/platform previews and charges are explicit. Footbridge type selects concrete, brown wood or green wood and is consumed by passage/stair outlooks and floating previews. Historical ACTION-009 unused-selector claim is superseded for ExAV. Empty-voxel branches remain separately incomplete; material support does not close all footbridge construction.

findings.title: Options include game rules and local presentation
findings.behavior: ConfigDialog adds train labels, electric-pole visibility, station/train font and color dialogs (8–16 designer limits), bankruptcy message flag and liquidity increments 10^10/10^11/10^12. Bankruptcy options affect shared gameplay and need an authority policy; font/color/visibility adapt to local browser presentation. Native allocation remains a portable disposition. Do not put authoritative economy settings into local preferences.

findings.title: Direct buildings lack historical main-menu route
findings.behavior: MainWindow commercial and variable-height commands are commented out; generic picker enumerates GenericStructureContribution, not the 66 commercial/55 variable-height declarations. Retain development-driven use and content accounting. Direct placement UI needs an explicit planned adaptation; do not transfer historical reachable builder status or interpret absent menu as excluded content. Variable-height direct builder/remover stubs remain open.

findings.title: Road extension source defect changed
findings.behavior: ExAV RoadAccessory ControllerForm declares PreviewDrawer drawer in its using statement: historical ACTION-006 undeclared-drawer claim does not apply. No RoadAccessory or DummyCar instance contribution types appear in bundled declarations. Registered menu/factory shells do not establish working bus simulation; selection/null behavior and obsolete DummyCarController still require per-source review.

findings.title: Generic category navigation is Japanese
findings.behavior: CategoryTreeWnd searches the Japanese menu label, so historical ACTION-005 exact English-label defect is no longer the right finding. Exact-label and index navigation remain brittle. Category changes invoke OnNodeSelected only when subscribed. Preserve stable category/design/color/direction/height identity and transaction cost; translate presentation without changing lookup identities.

findings.title: Save dialog and source loader diverge
findings.behavior: ExAV save dialog warns for .ftgd while using updated file filters. BZ detection remains but the BZip2InputStream wrapping line is removed. UI/file extension recognition is not proof of historical import support; assign serializer/default/continuation and compression diagnosis to P0-05.

findings.title: Temporary external music stays excluded
findings.behavior: BGMManager and BGMContributionFactoryImpl permit user-file selection and fileName state. Preserve source evidence, but owner excludes A4/external user-file equivalents; bundled BGM, silence, sound effects and departure bells remain in scope. Neither temporary contributions nor saved fileName authorizes redistributing music or enabling the optional pack.

findings.title: Development tuning is registered in ExAV
findings.behavior: System manifest {develop-config} registers DevelopConfigurePlugin, which merges a menu and opens DevelopConfigure. Historical ACTION-007 source-only disposition is superseded. Apply parses building-price, replacement, diffusion, station-range and land-value parameters; Save writes Core.options.devParams, Load repopulates controls, Cancel closes. Source stores preferences separately from world state and does not automatically reload them on restart. Define server-authoritative parameter edits and continuation/validation policy; local browser settings cannot change shared development rules. Apply assigns fields sequentially inside try/finally and disposes even on parse failure; browser validation/commit must prevent partial authoritative updates.

findings.title: Group delegation is registered, despite defect warning
findings.behavior: World registers DelegationTrainControllerImpl alongside SimpleTrainControllerImpl for non-temporary worlds; TrainPlacementController binds the world controller collection. This supersedes historical ACTION-001 source-only/unregistered status. The NO THIS DOES NOT WORK comment remains a defect warning, not proof of unreachability. Resolve null controller, root fallback, reparenting, cycles, assignment and continuation during P5/P10; do not assume the warning authorizes removing inheritance.

dependencyDecisions.decision: All 56 manifest dependency IDs resolve within the bundled ledger. Preserve deterministic transitive load order and existing contribution/resource identity evidence; optional packs remain separate. No implicit sibling lookup.

P0-02 source/project bindings resolve declared classes. Old core Compile/resource omissions and selected TAT Straight.bmp resource gaps remain explicit build/asset obligations, not grounds to remove reachable workflows.

EntityBuilderContribution and TwoDimStructure have no selected-project membership. Keep behavioral requirements/recipes; choose portable interfaces and rendering from source dependency review during the owning slice, without claiming source buildability.

Windows docking, DirectXWrapper, global keyboard polling, fonts, native memory allocation and browser-host controls require portable UI/input/rendering adaptations. Preserve current shell, authority, draft/readiness and lease boundaries.

Delegation warning, direct-building entry/stubs, empty extensions, partial development Apply, timetable BinaryFormatter and static balance sheet have explicit workflow dispositions. Detailed rule/save/transaction fixture closure belongs to owning slices and P0-04–06 where applicable.

runtimeRegistrations.decision: World adds SimpleTrainControllerImpl singleton. Engine default/assignment choice, not a third manifest controller provider.
World adds delegation singleton; warning and fallback/null/group cases remain P5/P10 detail. No independent contribution ID is fabricated.

BGMFactoryContributionFactory appends locally generated tracks to the owning plugin, separate from global registration; P0-02 retains nine excluded A4 local children. No bundled player command is added.
Temporary user-file selection is owner-excluded; fileName state does not create a current catalog or redistribution requirement.

sliceCompletionRequirements: Resolve every relevant control/action effect, default, validation and configuration scope against pinned ExAV and complete its detailed dependency closure before declaring the feature complete.
Attach reciprocal MAN/DEV requirement/source/workflow links for the implemented feature; record disagreements, exclusions and authoring/proposal dispositions explicitly.

Classify relevant C#/resx/HTML/XML text as presentation or non-presentation with a reason; review English donor meaning and Japanese text/IDs, then deliver both locales and interpolation/layout checks.
Record authority/draft/atomicity adaptations and source defects explicitly; verify relevant functional, content, persistence and recovery scenarios with independent expectations.
Keep source-scope review status separate from implementation/verification. A deferred task remains mandatory for its slice and P9/P11 closure.
